# lib/console module

Line-based command dispatcher over lib/serial. This page is the reference for the `lib/console` HAL module, for firmware authors choosing and wiring it in.

## Limits

- Not built for PIC16F870, PIC16F871, PIC16F872, PIC16F873, PIC16F873A, PIC16F874, PIC16F874A, PIC16LF873A, PIC18F2455, PIC18F2550. Reason: RAM: does not fit on this smaller part.
